app_info.subtitle: Pakistani Legal Assistant & Search
app_info.description: AL WAKEELO is your digital legal assistant that searches 600,000+ Pakistani case laws and statutes, drafts CPC-compliant petitions and commercial contracts, and conducts deep legal research.

tools.name: search_case_law
tools.justification: Queries the database for matching Pakistani court judgments and case law.

tools.name: search_statutes
tools.justification: Queries acts, ordinances, and sections from Pakistani statutory laws.

tools.name: get_judgment
tools.justification: Fetches the full-text content of a specific judgment by UUID.

tools.name: legal_research
tools.justification: Queries the full legal RAG retrieval system for comprehensive research answers.

tools.name: draft_petition
tools.justification: Generates CPC-compliant court petition text based on facts, topic, and case law.

tools.name: draft_contract
tools.justification: Generates commercial contracts under the Contract Act 1872 based on parties and terms.
